title: Montgomery County Council FAQ: Is Bethesda a city? Silver Spring?
key_finding: Montgomery County lists 19 municipalities and states that the rest of the County is not in a municipality, which means Silver Spring is not a municipality.

title: Maryland Manual: Montgomery County Municipalities
publisher: Maryland State Archives / Maryland Manual Online
key_finding: The official Maryland Manual lists Montgomery County's 19 municipalities and does not include Silver Spring, reinforcing that Silver Spring is not an incorporated municipality.

title: District 3D Silver Spring
key_finding: Montgomery County Police operates the 3rd District Station - Silver Spring, showing policing is through MCPD rather than a Silver Spring municipal police department.

title: Montgomery County Police Department Homepage
key_finding: MCPD is the county police department and its patrol bureau is organized into county police districts, including Silver Spring.

title: Silver Spring Regional Services About Us
key_finding: Silver Spring Regional Services is described as a county local government office serving the Silver Spring region and coordinating County Government agencies, not as a municipal government.

title: Regional Service Centers / Urban Districts
key_finding: The Silver Spring Urban District is a Montgomery County urban district program, not an incorporated city or town government.

title: Community Links: Municipalities and Communities
key_finding: Montgomery County distinguishes incorporated municipalities from unincorporated communities and points readers to the Maryland Manual for the formal municipal list.

title: U.S. Census QuickFacts: Silver Spring CDP
column7: The Census Bureau identifies Silver Spring as a CDP, confirming the place is a census-designated place rather than an incorporated municipality.
